metadata.description: KIFF Plugins (beta) for Claude Code: delegated authority for the AI agents your company runs.

plugins.name: kiff-cards
plugins.description: Beta. Give each AI agent an authority card: which actions it may take, how much, and who approves the rest. For companies whose agents act on their money and customer accounts.

plugins.name: kiff
plugins.description: Beta, optional. Shows what is left on the agent's KIFF Card in the status line, says when KIFF holds a call and when the owner answers it, and lists this session's KIFF calls in a /kiff pane. Use with kiff-cards.
